findings.title: A v3 subject labels its own speaker 'This v2' at six sites, naming the frozen Claude-REJECT occupancy as the thing that remasures occupancy
sites: basedOn.namingV6.role (line 21): 'This v2 remasures occupancy of that unversioned identifier.'
basedOn.d086.role (line 148): 'This v2 remasures occupancy after that recording.'
basedOn.d179.role (line 152): 'This v2 remasures occupancy after that recording.'
basedOn.d206.role (line 156): 'This v2 remasures occupancy after that recording.'
basedOn.d212.role (line 160): 'G10 occupancy v2 recorded. This v2 remasures G14 occupancy after that recording.'
failsIf[1] (line 345): 'is claimed closed by this v2 file existing rather than by leftover-join.v4 (D-179)'
findings.why: The subject is artifact 'harness.DR-G14.language-runtime-ux.typescript.v3' with version 3, and it exists to answer exactly one question: which version occupies the already-named identifier. It answers that question inconsistently in its own bytes. Elsewhere it speaks correctly and version-neutrally as 'This specification' (33 sites), 'This file', 'This remasurement', and twice explicitly as 'This v3' / 'this v3' (proposedLaterWork[3] and [4], plus proposedLaterWork[0] 'may pin this v3 occupancy'). At the six sites above it instead says 'This v2'. Those six sentences directly contradict basedOn.predecessorV2.role, which states of v2 'Not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement', and contradict doesNot[28] 'Does not record frozen v2 as a current occupancy remasurement' and proposedLaterWork[6] 'Do not record v1 or v2 as current'. The five basedOn.role sites are recital lines of exactly the form a later D-000 recording is drafted from, and each reads as an assertion that v2 remasures occupancy after D-086 / D-179 / D-206 / D-212 — the precise recording the lineage forbids.
aggravating: basedOn.namingV6.role closes with the disambiguator 'Not this artifact's version number', which disambiguates naming v6's version only. It leaves the 'This v2' in the same sentence standing as the artifact's self-label, so the one clause that exists to prevent version confusion resolves it in the wrong direction.

basedOn.d212.role uses 'v2' twice in adjacent sentences with two different referents — first correctly for the G10 occupancy v2 that D-212 recorded, then as this artifact's self-label. A reader can reasonably bind 'This v2' to the G10 artifact just named, which is the one identifier the same sentence disclaims occupying.

failsIf[1] is a functional defect, not only a label. failsIf is the artifact's own self-test array. As written, failsIf[1] tests whether OBL-G14-HARNESS-SPEC is 'claimed closed by this v2 file existing', so this v3 file existing does not trip it. The immediately adjacent failsIf[2] uses the correct 'this file existing' for OBL-G14-FX-AUTHORING, which shows the v2 wording is stale carry-over rather than a deliberate reference to the predecessor.
findings.notABlockerBecause: The machine-readable identity fields are correct and unambiguous: artifact ends in .v3, version is 3, basedOn.predecessorV2 pins the v2 path and digest separately and marks it frozen and non-recordable, and recordedInputs pins v2's three digests as inputs rather than as the speaker. The substantive content of all six sentences is accurate about D-086, D-179, D-206 and D-212; only the speaker is misnamed. A recorder pinning subject path and digest would pin v3 bytes. This is graded at the top of SHOULD-FIX and sits on the blocker boundary, because the defect is in occupancy identity — the single thing this artifact is for — and because it defeats one entry of the artifact's own guardrail array.
findings.remedy: Replace the six 'This v2' / 'this v2' speaker labels with the version-neutral 'This specification' / 'this file' already used at 33 other sites, or with 'This v3'. Do not renumber the artifact and do not touch the accurate historical 'v2' references in basedOn.predecessorV2, basedOn.leftoverJoinV2, basedOn.d165, purpose, registerRowNote, authorityClaim, failsIf[0], failsIf[3], doesNot[27], doesNot[28], proposedLaterWork[6] or remeasurementClause, all of which correctly speak about a different artifact. In basedOn.d212.role, keep 'G10 occupancy v2 recorded' unchanged. In failsIf[1], 'this v2 file existing' must become 'this file existing' to match failsIf[2] so the self-test binds this subject.
